name: auradev
description: AuraDev - Estudio de Desarrollo Digital. Monorepo con frontend (React + Vite) y backend (Express + PostgreSQL).

scripts.dev: npm run dev:clean && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c yellow,red "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test && npm --prefix backend run test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
